chunks: Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shazaan, Ibn Abi Umayr, from Muawiya ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I do not recognize Qunut except before the Ruku'.
ai.seo_question: When should Qunut be performed in the prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies that the recognized Qunut is performed before the bowing (Ruku'), a view primarily associated with the Hanafi school and supported by specific Shia narrations. This statement serves to distinguish the pre-Ruku' supplication from the post-Ruku' Qunut practiced by other schools, highlighting the diversity in juristic interpretation regarding the timing of this voluntary act within the obligatory prayer structure.
